name: demo-support-macro
text:
OpenAI API pricing and platform notes (support macro, 2024):

GPT-4o costs $5 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens. GPT-4o mini costs $0.15 per million input tokens and $0.60 per million output tokens. The Batch API offers a 50% discount on both models. GPT-4o was released in May 2024. The Assistants API is the recommended way to build agents on the OpenAI platform. GPT-4 Turbo costs $10 per million input tokens and $30 per million output tokens.

name: ceo-claim-no-digits
text: Sarah Chen is the chief executive officer of Northwind. Northwind charges $40 per seat per month for the Pro plan. The Pro plan includes audit logs and SSO. Northwind was founded in 2019.

name: current-stripe-version
text: The current Stripe API version is 2024-12-18. Stripe standard card fees are 2.9% plus 30 cents per transaction. Payouts take 2 to 5 business days.

name: notion-ai-pricing
text: Notion AI costs $10 per member per month as a standalone add-on. The Business plan includes Notion AI at $20 per member per month. Notion was founded in 2016.
